name: Colorado River (Grand Canyon)
gaugeName: Colorado River at Lees Ferry, AZ
blurb: Grand Canyon from Lees Ferry: multi-week whitewater trips. NPS permit required (weighted lottery for noncommercial trips); Diamond Creek take-out crosses Hualapai land.

sections.notes: NPS: Diamond Creek is river mile 225. NPS permit required (noncommercial weighted lottery). Hualapai Tribe charges separate fees to take out at Diamond Creek. Gauge at Lees Ferry is at the start; tributary inflow changes flow downstream.
sections.mapPendingReason: Diamond Creek (Grand Canyon): Research-only grade: access-verified (official source names boating access; approximate area only). Access crosses Hualapai tribal land and the Tribe charges its own fees; the managing authority for road and landing is the Hualapai Tribe, not NPS, so this stays in the access-verified tier.

sections.notes: NPS: 'the entire stretch to river mile 277 (Pearce Ferry) is free-flowing whitewater'; NPS regulations describe the river between 'river mile 0 at Lees Ferry and river mile 279 near Pearce Ferry'. Mileage uses 277 from the Diamond Creek page. Take out at Pearce Ferry or South Cove (NPS); the Pearce Ferry ramp is for Grand Canyon river-trip take-outs only (no launching). NPS permit required.

putInAccess.sourceName: NPS Glen Canyon NRA: Lees Ferry
putInAccess.note: Imagery: the NPS point is in the paved launch parking lot, about 60 m from the ramp and docks. Too far from the water to pass the ramp-at-water check. Official source names boating access, but the exact water-entry point is not pinned by an agency coordinate confirmed on imagery. Restrictions: permit-required
putInAccess.directions: The launch ramp and courtesy docks are beside the Lees Ferry launch parking lot (imagery).

takeOutAccess.sourceName: NPS Public POIs, OBJECTID 10448 'Pearce Ferry Boat Launch' (Boat Launch)
takeOutAccess.note: NPS Public POIs, OBJECTID 10448 'Pearce Ferry Boat Launch' (Boat Launch) is the managing agency's own point. Legal boating access: NPS Lake Mead NRA: South Cove Launch Ramp page (section 'Pearce Ferry Takeout', last updated Aug 20, 2026) (https://www.nps.gov/places/south-cove-launch-ramp.htm): 'The boat ramp at Pearce Ferry is for Grand Canyon river trip takeouts only. Launching watercraft is not allowed at Pearce Ferry.' NPS Grand Canyon: 'River runners can take-out at either South Cove or Pearce Ferry.' Imagery: Esri World Imagery z19 checked 2026-10-25 (research/raw/imagery/pearce_ferry_boat_launch.png): Point is on the paved ramp lane that runs down to the river; boats are pulled up at the bottom of the ramp. NHD flowline 98 m away. Take-out only: NPS prohibits launching watercraft at Pearce Ferry.
takeOutAccess.bankSourceName: USGS NHD High Resolution flowline (flow-direction digitized) + Esri World Imagery
takeOutAccess.bankNote: Facing downstream (flow bearing ~329), the point is left of the NHD centreline (98 m).

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.
